annotation.title_clean: 15 CFR Part 748—Applications (Classification, Advisory, and License) and Documentation
annotation.title_en: 15 CFR Part 748—Applications (Classification, Advisory, and License) and Documentation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: US Export Administration Regulations Part 748 sets procedures for BIS classification requests, advisory opinions, and export/reexport license applications. It includes AI model classification (ECCN 4E091), Validated End-User authorizations for advanced-computing data centers, supporting documents, and a robots-specific application requirement. Its focus is export control, not embodied AI governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Export and reexport license applications and classification requests must be filed electronically via SNAP-R, with limited paper exceptions.
Classification requests may confirm AI models are not controlled under ECCN 4E091.
Data Center VEU (Universal and National) authorizations for advanced computing ICs carry TPP allocations and security guidelines.
Support documents are required for PRC, Hong Kong, firearms and 600-series destinations.
Supplement 10 requires model-weight security, supply chain and personnel vetting, with enforcement by revocation.
